item.text: [{"task_id":"97c75046","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    obstacle = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    ball = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    directions = []","    for pair in params['directions']:","        directions.append((int(round(pair[0])), int(round(pair[1]))))","    out = grid.copy()","    stones = np.argwhere(grid == obstacle)","    balls = np.argwhere(grid == ball)","    if len(stones) == 0 or len(balls) == 0:","        return out","    h, w = grid.shape","    r, c = int(balls[0][0]), int(balls[0][1])","    gaps = [int(np.min(stones[:, 0])) - r, r - int(np.max(stones[:, 0])), int(np.min(stones[:, 1])) - c, c - int(np.max(stones[:, 1]))]","    axis = int(np.argmax(np.array(gaps)))","    dr, dc = directions[axis]","    out[r, c] = bg","    for step in range(h * w):","        nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc","        if nr < 0 or nr >= h or nc < 0 or nc >= w:","            break","        if out[nr, nc] != bg:","            break","        r, c = nr, nc","    lateral = None","    for step in range(h * w):","        moved = False","        for lr, lc in directions:","            if dr * lr + dc * lc != 0:","                continue","            if lateral is not None and (lr, lc) != lateral:","                continue","            nr, nc = r + dr + lr, c + dc + lc","            if nr < 0 or nr >= h or nc < 0 or nc >= w:","                continue","            if out[nr, nc] != bg:","                continue","            touching = False","            for ar, ac in directions:","                rr, cc = nr + ar, nc + ac","                if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:","                    if out[rr, cc] == obstacle:","                        touching = True","            if touching:","                r, c = nr, nc","                lateral = (lr, lc)","                moved = True","                break","        if not moved:","            break","    out[r, c] = ball","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"directions":[4,2]},"params":{"colors":[7,0,5],"directions":[[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]},"rationale":"The gray ball approaches the black region from its initial side, then rolls diagonally along its surface while remaining in contact, stopping when further rolling is blocked or loses contact."}]
